name: a-value-that-is-no-account-is-not-a-candidate
breaks: a stored value that is no account (the sentinel `unknown`, a display name with a space) is counted toward the five collaborator slots, so a post with five real accounts and nothing to decide is ranked as though somebody had to be cut, and the same value is then offered as one of five invites and written into the exported CAPTIONS.txt (#981, #964)
